name: Hip Abduction Machine
cues: Sit tall with your back against the pad
Set the pads on the outside of your knees
Push your knees apart as wide as the machine allows
Control the return without letting the stack touch down

qa.note: Family review 2026-10-01 rated minor. review: Fixed two things. The glute med (primary) is now tinted on the right hip in every frame: before, the forearm covered it and it only showed in half the frames. The arms also hang naturally now; before, the elbows were bent 83 deg with the upper arms 61 deg up behind the trunk. ROM is 8 to 40 deg per side at hip 90 / knee 80, pads outside the knees, feet on the pegs. For the owner: the camera is now -52/0.45, higher and more to the side than the approved -35/0.3, so the near knee's travel partly points at the lens. The seat still hides the lower glutes. | skeptic: Movement is right.
